almostIncluded.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Tainted Pact by paying {1}{B}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: No two cards in library share a name.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Animate Dead until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Abdel Adrian.
Animate Dead returns to the battlefield, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming Laboratory Maniac and thus exiling your library due to you not having a card named Laboratory Maniac in your library.
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for any five other cards, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library and losing half your life, rounded up.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, winning the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least three devotion to blue.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}, drawing your library and then putting any card besides Thassa's Oracle from your hand on top of your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Eternal Witness and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Eternal Witness tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.

feature.name: Infinite mana permanents you control can produce
Return all cards from your graveyard to your hand
Infinite casts of instants and sorceries in your hand and graveyard

almostIncluded.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, reveal cards from the top of your library and then putting them into your graveyard.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, winning you the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You have no basic lands in library.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Demonic Tutor by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it into your hand.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming Jace, Wielder of Mysteries and thus exiling your library due to you not having a card named Jace, Wielder of Mysteries in your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to win the game.

Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, exiling Animate Dead.
Animate Dead leaves the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Leonin Relic-Warder.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from exile to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat from step 3.

Each time an opponent draws a card, Smothering Tithe triggers.
Opponents will eventually be unable to pay for Smothering Tithe due to Statis causing them to skip their untap steps, causing you to create a Treasure artifact token.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis triggers.
Holding priority, activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis ability, paying {U}.
Repeat.

Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it on top of your library and causing you to lose 2 life.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Thought Lash by exiling the top card of your library, preventing the next one damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Repeat step 1 until there are no cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield winning you the game.

Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Doubling Season.
Replication Technique's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you to copy it, with the copy targeting Doubling Season.
Resolve the copy of Replcation Technique, creating two token copies of Doubling Season.
Resolve the original Replication Technique, creating eight token copies of Doubling Season.
Create a creature token, causing you to instead create 2,048 creature tokens.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a creature token.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Paradigm Shift by paying {1}{U}, exiling your library and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: The number of cards in your graveyard is less than two plus your devotion to blue.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Deepglow Skate by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Deepglow Skate spell three times.
Resolve the first Deepglow Skate spell.
When the Deepglow Skate token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
almostIncluded.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Deepglow Skate spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

feature.name: Infinite copies of permanent spells you control

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, exiling the top six cards of your library and then revealing Approach of the Second Sun and putting it into your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Your deck size is at least seven.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Oracle for {U}{U}.
Tap and activate Divining Witch's ability for {1}{B} and discarding a card while your Oracle trigger is on the stack, naming a card not in your library.
Resolve Witch ability, exiling your library.
Resolve Oracle trigger, winning the game.

Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Kederekt Leviathan from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Kederekt Leviathan triggers, returning all nonland permanents to their owner's hands.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kederekt Leviathan.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

feature.name: Return all nonland permanents opponents control to their hand on each of your turns

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Jace by paying {1}{U}{U}. Jace enters the battlefield with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating four nonlegendary copies of Jace that enter the battlefield with six loyalty counters each due to Doubling Season.
Repeat step 2 using a Jace token.
almostIncluded.notes: Once you have infinite Jace tokens, you may activate their second loyalty abilities by removing two loyalty counters from them, creating infinite 2/2 Illusion creature tokens.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

feature.name: Infinite card draw for any number of players
Infinite draw triggers for any number of players

Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your library and choosing to put no cards on top of your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying six {B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 4.

almostIncluded.description:
During your upkeep, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, and draw a card.
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {1}{B}, naming Timestream Navigator and exiling your entire library except Timestream Navigator and putting Timestream Navigator into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
During your extra turn's upkeep, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, drawing Timestream Navigator.
Repeat from step 4.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: You have six or more cards in your library.
almostIncluded.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{B} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} each extra turn

Play Oracle.
Exile entire library to Devourer in response to etb.
Let Oracle resolve and win.

Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming a card not in your library and thus exiling your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.

At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Attack with Sun Titan, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Opponents can not kill Sun Titan when you attack.
Sun Titan does not have summoning sickness.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Sacred Guide for {1}{W}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle, winning the game on ETB.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: There are no white cards in library.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Wrath of God by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
almostIncluded.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Mordenkainen by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Mordenkainen enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Mordenkainen's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it.
Mordenkainen dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Mordenkainen ability, exchanging your hand and library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is equal to or greater than the number of cards in hand minus two.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Animate Dead triggers, sacrificing Worldgorger Dragon.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all permanents exiled by it to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate all lands you control by tapping those, adding manas of any colors those lands can produce.
Repeat.

Cast Dance with Calamity by paying {7}{R}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.
